title: Vegan Spanish Tomato Bake
description: A flavorful vegan dish that combines the sweetness of tomatoes with the tanginess of a Spanish-inspired sauce.
instructions: Toss cherry tomatoes with olive oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet.
Roast in the oven for 10-12 minutes, or until the tomatoes are tender.
Meanwhile, chop the bell pepper and sauté it in a pan with a bit of olive oil.
Add the vegan sour cream and stir to combine.
Transfer the roasted tomatoes to a baking dish.
Pour the sautéed pepper mixture over the tomatoes.
Bake for an additional 10-12 minutes, or until the breadcrumbs are golden brown.
Garnish with fresh basil and serve.
